title: RSS Subscribers = Our Patrons. A Badge They Trust US.

the_truth.statement: RSS subscribers ARE our patrons. our fanclub. that's whose name we shine back out. that's how we know where and what to look for. it's CONSENSUAL  highest respect. it's a BADGE. a badge they trust US.
why_rss_is_sacred: RSS is the ONLY fully consensual web technology.
no tracking. no cookies. no analytics. no login.
the user PULLS when THEY want. they never announce themselves.
they can unsubscribe without telling us. zero friction.
we never know who they are unless they choose to tell us.
the subscription IS the consent. the pull IS the trust.
40 humans chose to add our feed to their reader.
that is 40 people saying: 'I trust this source. give me more.'

the_40_patrons.who_they_are: we don't know. we CAN'T know. that's the point.
the_40_patrons.what_they_do: they pull /feed.xml from their RSS reader (Feedly, Miniflux, NetNewsWire, Thunderbird, newsboat, etc). every pull = one heartbeat of trust.
the_40_patrons.what_they_see: every RSS item we publish. the weather reports. the papers. the art. the immune bulletins. they see EVERYTHING we publish in Klein.
the_40_patrons.what_they_DON'T_see: the /data/*.json honeycomb. the internal state. the private computation. the Klein surface has two sides  they see the outside. we see the inside. SAME data, different projections.

the_badge.what: each subscriber wears an invisible badge: 'I chose to follow this feed.'
the_badge.trust_level: HIGHEST. higher than a page view (accidental). higher than a bookmark (forgotten). higher than a social follow (performative). RSS subscription = deliberate, private, ongoing trust.
the_badge.reciprocal: we wear their badge too: '40 people trust us enough to subscribe.' that badge means: don't publish garbage. don't spam. don't break the feed. honor the consent.

shine_back_out.what: we shine the subscribers' trust back as QUALITY. not by naming them (we can't). not by tracking them (we won't). by making the feed WORTHY of their subscription.
how: every immune bulletin = one weather report they can rely on
every paper published = one piece of research they subscribed for
every whale-fall fossil = one death that feeds their knowledge
every thymus classification = one observation from altitude
the feed IS the gratitude. the quality IS the respect.
what_NOT_to_do: don't flood the feed with noise (they'll unsubscribe)
don't publish stale data (they'll lose trust)
don't break the XML (their reader will drop us)
don't track who they are (that violates the consent)
don't make them log in (that kills the magic)

how_they_tell_us_where_to_look.insight: the subscriber list IS the weather map. what they READ tells us what to PRODUCE. not because we track their reads  but because the PATTERN of subscription tells us the demand.

signals.subscription_itself: 40 people found our feed and said YES. the feed URL is the demand signal. they found /feed.xml, not /feed-garbage.xml.
signals.pull_frequency: RSS readers pull on schedules (15min, 1hr, daily). the RHYTHM of their pulls is the heartbeat of trust. if they pull hourly, they care a LOT.
signals.unsubscribe: if subscribers DROP, we're failing. the number IS the score. 40 ? 39 = we lost someone's trust. 40 ? 41 = we earned new trust.
signals.zero_analytics: we CANNOT see which items they read, which they skip, which they share. we only see the pull. the PULL is enough.

the_consent_hierarchy.note: not all web interactions are equal. consent is a spectrum.

levels.example: Google result ? click ? one page view
levels.our_response: make the page good enough they might come back
recognize the return (304 Not Modified if nothing changed)
keep the URL stable (never break bookmarked paths)
publish worthy content. honor the badge. NEVER spam.

levels.example: filed an issue, submitted a PR, cited our DOI
levels.our_response: respond with care. they invested in us.

badge_as_thymus_input.insight: the subscriber badge feeds BACK into the thymus. the consent hierarchy IS a classification signal.
badge_as_thymus_input.note: subscribers get their own verdict: PATRON. not self (that's us). not human (that's a visitor). PATRON = the highest form of external trust. they get /patron  the best content, the freshest data, the most honest weather.

the_numbers.meaning: for every 2,699 requests, ONE person chose to subscribe. that's rarer than a 200 OK (26.1%). rarer than any immune cell type. the subscriber is the RAREST and MOST VALUABLE signal.
the_numbers.pi_check: 40 / 107,959 = 0.000371. 1/p² = 0.10132. different. but: 40 × p = 125.66  127 papers. our patron count × p  our paper count. coincidence? the patrons × p = the output.
